mainText: Hello, Verona! At 4 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we are seeing 61 degrees with clear skies near Verona City Hall and a third quarter moon.

In city news, the Verona Senior Center is currently offering free tri-shaw bike rides along the Military Ridge State Trail, and the Recreation Department is seeking adult fitness instructors for our community.
We have several great local options today, including Yoga at Insight Wellness and Concerts in the Park at Century School Park, plus Hop Haus Trivia is also taking place today.
In our weekly look at local reports, on July 31, a driver was arrested for O W I after an officer initiated a stop for driving on a flat tire.
Culver's is currently closed, but they open at 10:00 AM today, so be sure to stop by and try their flavor of the day, the Chocolate Caramel Twist.
